text: Okay, new plan: I stand completely still and become school furniture. Nobody expects a chair to introduce the assembly. Why am I making eye contact with the duck? It's a toy, Nemi, it doesn't know anything. Nine, please. I'd rather do the speech than lose a staring contest to stuffing.
